nodes.name: Intent Signal Webhook
nodes.notes: Signed intent batches from Bombora, 6sense or G2 (or a relay). 5 pinned fictional deliveries.

nodes.name: Weekly Intent Poll
nodes.notes: Mondays 06:00 UTC: Bombora surge results, G2 buyer intent, decay rescoring.

nodes.name: Verify & Unwrap Intent Batch
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp.body) per source · 5-minute window · fails closed.

nodes.name: Fetch Bombora Surge
nodes.notes: Company Surge report results (JSON) · URL and auth header from env.

nodes.name: Find Companies to Rescore
nodes.notes: Scored companies not refreshed for RESCORE_AFTER_DAYS → decay applied.

nodes.name: Intent Normalizer & Weighting Engine
nodes.notes: Per-source 0–100 scores · topic and visit-type weights · one item per domain.

nodes.name: Compute Account Intent Score
nodes.notes: Decay · composite intent · ICP fit · account score · tier · review flag.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: Hashed domain refs, scores, tiers · no contacts or raw provider payloads.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-multisource-intent-data-account-scorer
Bombora + 6sense + G2 intent → normalized source scores → decay + ICP fit → composite account intent score on HubSpot companies. DH Robin · dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. No provider or HubSpot calls until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute the webhook and the weekly poll with their pinned fictional data.
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real providers + HubSpot lookups, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: scores and tiers go live.

No contacts are created or read. Every tier change is a flag for a person to review.

### Scoring
intent = 0.6 × strongest source + 0.4 × weighted mean (+ corroboration) · account = 0.6 × intent + 0.4 × fit · decay half-life 14 days.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers or bodies. API keys, tokens and webhook URLs are redacted.
